changelog:
Initial release of the iplay skill.

- Control the iPlay media player to play videos or streams using URLs.
- Supports YouTube, Bilibili, and direct media links (mp4, m3u8, etc.).
- Automatically handles iplay:// URI schemes and base64-encodes URLs for compatibility.
- Works on macOS, Windows, and Linux (requires Python 3 and iPlay installed).
- Triggers playback asynchronously; does not monitor playback status.
